title: iss063m262051358_Expedition_63_Progress_76_launch_200723
description: RUSSIAN CARGO SHIP DELIVERS SUPPLIES TO THE INTERNATIONAL SPACE STATION  An unpiloted Russian cargo ship blasted off from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan July 23 on a delivery mission to bring some three tons of food, fuel and hardware to the residents of the International Space Station. The ISS Progress 76 craft arrived at the complex less than four hours after launch, automatically docking to the Pirs Docking Compartment on the Russian segment of the station where it will spend a little more than three months.
keywords: Expedition 63, Progress 76 Launch, Progress Cargo Vehicle, International Space Station
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
